• scripts/ops/deploy-config.sh --slot staging|prod --sha <merged main sha> --reason "..." copies only scraper/config/field-manifest.json from that sha into $ROOT/shared/config/<slot>/ (never into a release: releases stay immutable, review finding 7), verifies the file hash, writes CONFIG_SHA, and appends a log line with who, when, sha and reason. Every release's own scraper/config/field-manifest.json is a symlink to that shared file.
